items.prompt: Two records share ID T1. What does a dictionary comprehension keyed only by trade_id do?

options.text: It preserves both values under the same scalar key
options.why: An ordinary dictionary holds one value per key.

options.text: It rejects duplicates without an explicit check
options.why: Dictionary construction does not reject these duplicates.

options.text: It converts the records into a nested list automatically
It keeps the later assigned value for that key
options.why: Later assignment replaces the earlier value.

items.explanation: A key maps to one value. A duplicate-detection or grouping policy must be implemented explicitly before the earlier record is lost.
